title: Constraint: Split Into Three Queues
constraints: Distribute the items 1 … 12 into three queues `q[0]`, `q[1]`, `q[2]`: each item in exactly one queue.
All three queues are non-empty and have **different** sizes. The testbench calls `randomize()` and then inspects `q`.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Queues themselves are hard to constrain directly. Randomize an assignment (`owner[i]` = queue of item i) and build the queues in `post_randomize()`.
Queue sizes are counts: `owner.sum() with (int'(item == k))`.
Remember to clear the queues at the start of `post_randomize()`, since the object is randomized many times.

examples.check: every item 1..12 is in exactly one queue
